summary: This feature spotlights community basketball leagues as engines of youth development, community bonding and local economic activity. It follows the South End Hoops Fest opening on September 5, 2023 and profiles coaches, players and business owners who describe mentorship, sportsmanship, health, academics, diversity, girls' participation and technology. It closes with upcoming events and a veteran coach's reflections.
one_line: A feature on how community basketball leagues build youth character, health, academics, inclusion and local economies, centered on the South End Hoops Fest.
key_facts: The annual South End Hoops Fest opened on September 5, 2023 at the South End Community Center.
Mayor Janine O'Connor unveiled a freshly donated scoreboard at the opening ceremonies, marking the official start of the season.
Marcus Ellington of the Riverside Raptors says, "Basketball's more than a sport... it's a means to teach these kids life lessons."
Tanya Bennett, a former college star, now coaches the Midtown Mavericks and stresses constructive criticism and encouragement.
Starting September 12, local health clinics partnered with the leagues, and Dr. Armando Huerta ran workshops on sports nutrition and exercise, including a free throw clinic.
Fifteen-year-old Jasmine Carter is cited as a student-athlete succeeding on the court and in the classroom; Thursday's "Books and Basketball" night supports players' academics.
Vasquez's Pizzeria, owned by Roberto Vasquez, has become a post-game mainstay and benefits from increased game-day business.
The Lin brothers moved to the community from Taiwan two years ago and are cited as an example of sports as a cross-cultural bridge.
Seventeen-year-old Isaiah Thomas has been scouted since age 15, drawing attention from media and prestigious sports programs.
The Shattering Glass Backboards initiative gives female athletes a dedicated platform; coach Beatrice Alvarez is a former WNBA player.
Leagues use apps for live scoring and scheduling, and coaches use video analysis tools for training.
The Halloween Hoops Tournament is set for October 31 and the Thanksgiving Charity Game for November 25.
Elijah Harris, a 20-year coaching veteran, leads the Eastside Eagles, a perennial favorite in the league finals.
